description: This file contains various utility functions for formatting and styling output in the terminal, including functions for colorizing text, formatting key-value pairs, tags, separators, and truncating strings. It also exports a function to determine if the output should be rich (colored).

methods.name: isRich
methods.description: Determines if the terminal output should be styled with colors and formatting, based on environment and options.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads a string to the specified size using spaces at the end.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Colorizes a key string if rich formatting is enabled.

methods.name: formatValue
methods.description: Colorizes a value string if rich formatting is enabled.

methods.name: formatKeyValue
methods.description: Formats and colorizes a key-value pair into a string.

methods.name: formatSeparator
methods.description: Returns a separator string styled with the muted theme.

methods.name: formatTag
methods.description: Styles a tag string based on its content and whether rich formatting is enabled.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates a string to the maximum length, adding ellipsis if necessary.

ctags.name: formatKey
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatKey = (key: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.warn, key);$/

ctags.name: formatValue
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatValue = (value: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.info, value);$/

ctags.name: isRich
ctags.pattern: /^export const isRich = (opts?: { json?: boolean; plain?: boolean }) =>$/

ctags.name: pad
ctags.pattern: /^export const pad = (value: string, size: number) => value.padEnd(size);$/
